response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong web, backend, and distributed-systems skills, but the role demands deep, current C++ expertise in industrial automation with IEC 62443 security practices. His C++ exposure is minimal and dated (a short stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project), his recent decade centers on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web platforms, and there is no evidence of MQTT, industrial protocols, or SDL/IEC 62443 experience. The core skills mismatch outweighs his general seniority.
strengths: 16+ years of software engineering experience with strong seniority and ownership
Solid low-latency, high-throughput, and event-driven systems experience (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong mentoring, testing culture (TDD), and technical communication demonstrated through workshops and talks
concerns: Very limited and outdated C++/STL experience relative to a C++-centric role
No demonstrated IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity background
No industrial automation, MQTT, or OT-protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.) experience

key_factors.factor: Strong general seniority and distributed-systems background
